title: Console focus ring harmonization, color token updates, and globalization readiness for dashboards & rollout flows
creator: Ava Patel
description: Unify keyboard focus visuals across Console dashboards and rollout pages, replace ad-hoc color uses with semantic color tokens, and validate layout/typography behaviors for globalized content (RTL and wide-character locales). Goal is to close outstanding WCAG failures, improve keyboard navigation predictability, and ensure visual tokens adapt to localized surface area and typography.
acceptance_criteria: All interactive controls in Dashboard and Rollouts flows have visible, consistent focus styles that persist across themes and zoom levels and meet minimum contrast targets.
Color uses converted to semantic tokens (interactive/hover/disabled/border/background-muted/brand-accent) and documented in the design token spec.
Keyboard navigation order matches visual flow; keyboard-only users can access critical actions (create rollout, pause, view cost breakdown) without trap.
RTL layout passes visual QA without clip or overlap; number/date fields render localized separators and direction appropriately.
Automated axe and Lighthouse runs for affected pages return no new critical WCAG violations (must remediate any >=AA failures discovered).
Design handoff artifacts (Figma + tokens table + redlines) uploaded and linked in ticket.
tasks: Audit current focus styles across components used in dashboards and rollouts (cards, tables, primary/secondary buttons, dropdowns, toggles).
Create standardized focus token set: focus-ring-color, focus-ring-size, focus-ring-radius, focus-offset.
Map all color instances on affected pages to semantic tokens and propose contrast adjustments where token values fall below 3:1 for UI or 4.5:1 for body text.
Prototype keyboard-only flows for complex widgets (rollout rule editor, cost filter pane) and capture focus order diagrams.
Run RTL QA on Figma prototypes and update constraints for components that truncate incorrectly (bad ellipsis behavior with bidi text).
Prepare redlines and token key-value JSON for engineering consumption; include example CSS usage and a11y rationale.
review_feedback: PM (Elena Gómez): Ensure focus hits cost breakdown chart legends; users with keyboard nav need a way to expand legend items without pointer.
Engineering (Samir Kapoor): Prefer 2px focus rings for high-density tables but we may need a compact token variant; will try with runtime theming support in runtime-1.21 branch.
Accessibility consultant (Jared Mills): Recommend using a combination of outline + subtle shadow to preserve contrast when backgrounds change; avoid using only color shift for focus state.
accessibility_issues: Current table row focus relies on background swap that fails 4.5:1 in dark theme (WCAG AA text contrast).
Some icon-only buttons lack accessible labels and rely on title attributes (axe: 'aria-label' required).
Keyboard focus not visible when system focus indicators are suppressed (user agent override).
Focus order mismatch on Rollout Editor between 'Add rule' and inline filter controls causes unexpected jumps.
localization_considerations: RTL: Ensure horizontal control stacks (action groups on cards) flip order and maintain logical tab order; test with Hebrew/Arabic strings.
Number formatting: cost cards must accept localized separators (comma/period) and still allow sorting/filtering; add tests for fr-FR and de-DE locales.
Date/time: use localized short date tokens; verify compact date chips don't truncate critical info in CJK locales.
Text expansion: UI must tolerate +30% string length without clipping buttons; adjust min-width or allow wrap where appropriate.
decisions: Adopt semantic token set and deprecate hard-coded hex values in component library for affected components.
Use 2px solid focus ring with 8px offset token for dense table rows and 3px for larger interactive elements; both must meet contrast targets.
Introduce a11y checklist for PRs touching dashboard/rollout UI and add an automated Lighthouse job for these routes in CI.
next_steps: Address Samir's compact token variant comment and produce updated token JSON by 2026-03-12.
Implement visual QA pass in staging with axe/lighthouse snapshots and collect defects.
Handoff: deliver tokens + redlines to ENG-2012 and schedule a 30m sync for engineering questions.
